rendered: The anode-free full cell (presodiated pyrite cathode paired with carbon/Al current collectors) reaches a delivered energy density of ∼400 Wh/kg[1] (the value is calculated from the mass of the presodiated pyrite and the carbon nucleation layer; the cycling data are shown in Figure 4c[2]). The paper's stated theoretical maximum for LIB technology is 387 Wh/kg for LiCoO2/graphite cells[3]. So the anode-free cell's value is slightly above that LiCoO2/graphite theoretical figure. The authors also note that, assuming a 50%[4] packaging penalty, the cell still exceeds current LIB technology.
